page.overview:
What is Outer La Noscea?

Outer La Noscea is a location in Final Fantasy XIV.

Outer La Noscea is located on the foothills of O'Ghomoro.

This zone connects to Upper La Noscea in the west and east.

A Maelstrom military camp located high up on Outer La Noscea, overlooking the Wanderer's Palance and Upper La Noscea environs. Run by ex-pirates known as the Red Swallows, this camp monitors the activities of kobolds and their stronghold of U'Ghamaro Mines, and as such is the only place of respite adventurers may find up here.
